The biggest and brightest stars have been selected to the 2026 MLS All-Star Game! Each 11-card set contains the complete ten base card set plus a base parallel, autograph parallel, or Match-used net jewel 1/1 relic or autograph-relic redemption.

Product-level bundle configuration; no per-card print run, pack probability or exact family-wide numbering is inferred from this sentence. The 11-card configuration contains ten base cards plus one additional card; the PDF lists 26 possible entries.
